Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin currency/CPI skill with the key pitfall:

- For YoY CPI-U inflation “after applying the rate,” multiply by CPI[current month] / CPI[same month previous year].
- Do not divide unless converting into prior-year dollars.
- Sanity check: with positive YoY inflation, adjusted amount should be larger than nominal.

Also updated memory with the compact durable rule.
